text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Kepler Analytics flagged as at-risk. Renewal in ~45 days. Usage down ~42% last 30d; three tickets about model latency and a stalled adoption of batch endpoints. Need a short 'renewal runway' tactical play: PS deep-dive, enablement refresh, temporary credit to unblock evaluation, and a short feedback capture to understand friction. Who can own what? :wave:

oliver_csm: I can own exec comms and run the renewal sync. Free Tue/Thu mornings this week. I'll open a brief agenda for the exec call (10–15m) + a technical deep-dive after. @devon_ps can you scope a 2-week PS surge?

devon_ps: Yep — I can scope. Proposal draft: 2-week surge (3 onsite/remote sessions): day 0 infra & latency audit, day 2 prompt/ops tuning, day 5 integration checklist + checklist-driven A/B on inference profile. Will include a list of quick wins (kernel/quant tweaks, KV cache hints). Will post a scope doc by EOD.

ashley_success: I'll run the feedback capture: short 5-question survey after each session and a 1:1 adoption interview with their ML lead. Also propose a conditional usage credit (30% on next invoice) tied to hitting adoption milestones in the play.

lia_onboard: I'll re-send the onboarding checklist and spin up an 'advanced queries' training invite for their data team. I can also prepare a tailored runbook: quick-start templates, example payloads, and a checklist for their infra team to check (network + batching knobs).

onboard-bot: Meeting created — "Kepler Renewal Runway" Tue 10:00AM PT. Invites sent to kepler@kepler-analytics.com, maria_cs, oliver_csm, devon_ps, lia_onboard. Zoom + calendar link in the invite.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll create a CS ops ticket and map owners. Quick action items I captured:
- oliver_csm: lead exec sync + update renewal notes
- devon_ps: post PS surge scope doc by EOD with day-by-day plan and success metrics
- lia_onboard: training invite + tailored runbook by Wed
- ashley_success: survey + conditional credit proposal
- maria_cs: create ops ticket and run initial kickoff with the customer; share notes back to thread

Linking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-9876 (created).

If we can get the scope and calendar locked this week, we should be in good shape to show momentum before the renewal window. I'll update the playbook with the 'runway' template after first session. :thumbsup:
